entities.summary: Michael Dickson is an Australian professional American football punter and holder for the Seattle Seahawks of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Texas Longhorns and was selected by the Seahawks in the fifth round of the 2018 NFL draft. Regarded as one of the best punters ever, his career punt average is ranked at fourth in NFL history, only behind AJ Cole, Blake Gillikin, and Jack Fox.
